liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this arguably the best Eyes they have heard, with an unmatched intro jam and sustained energy; Reviewer praises the Eyes as a standout [6][13][14]
- **Happiness Is Drumming** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears the Happiness Is Drumming jam as a sweet Fire on the Mountain preview; Reviewer found hearing this proto-Fire jam beautiful [14][16]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer found Scarlet great, hearing the bass as fretless-sounding [8]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (1 review): Reviewer especially likes the Lazy Lightnin' into Supplication pairing [17]
- **High Time** (1 review): Donna's singing adds to High Time, which is rare, and Jerry's vocals are strong [14]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer likes the mid-70s treatment, a jazzy, downward-spiraling jam typical of the period [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happiness Is Drumming**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-28.shure.minches.18388.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 3.58/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience tape has no hiss and is fairly low generation, but the editing of crowd banter is weaker; Reviewer feels the mix and sound quality could be better; Reviewer admits the recording is weak [8][11][16]
- **gd1976-06-28.aud.unknown.vernon.9776.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer likes the room vibe of this audience recording [13]
- **gd1976-06-28.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112296.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 4.33/5 by 15 [3]
- **gd1976-06-28.mtx.seamons.112676.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says they sat about six rows from the stage and doesn't recall Fire being played [7]
- Reviewer argues Phil's slides were played on a fretted bass, not a fretless one [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-28.shure.minches.18388.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Shure 545s [1]
- **gd1976-06-28.aud.unknown.vernon.9776.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Dale Shepherd and Matt Vernon; source: AUDMR > ? > DAT > SHN [2]
- **gd1976-06-28.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112296.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [3]. Also: Patch source recorded with mics placed at the soundboard; digitized by Digitalrbb, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1976-06-28.mtx.seamons.112676.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [4]
